# Menu 227 (randomly register blinking) on morph4 of swing600.pmm, twice: the
# CRT rand() state and the blink phase carry over from the first run to the
# second. The info boxes with the counts go to messages.tsv.
load pmm swing600.pmm
select model morph4
register blink 0 300
save pmm blink1.pmm
select all morph
save vmd blink1.vmd
register blink 300 600
save pmm blink2.pmm
select all morph
save vmd blink2.vmd
